name: Jefferson River (Canyon / Three Forks)
blurb: Lime-cliff canyon by the Caverns, then braided water into Missouri Headwaters.

sections.notes: The Jefferson canyon. Long day. Lewis & Clark Caverns State Park is midway.
Popular short canyon float. The planning estimate excludes time spent scouting or portaging the diversion.

notices.title: Diversion on this stretch
notices.text: The trail guide identifies a substantial diversion near the cliffs between Sappington and Williams. Scout before approaching and be prepared to portage. A continuous safe passage is not established by the access pins.

sections.routeReview: A diversion lies within the stretch. Access maps remain useful, but a continuous dotted line is withheld until the barrier and portage can be shown explicitly.

sections.notes: River opens up and braids. Irrigation can drain this stretch in late summer.
Ends where the Jefferson, Madison, and Gallatin become the Missouri.
